welcome.title: Choose language
welcome.subtitle: Select how you want to use this practice app.

home.title: PMP practice simulator — PMBOK 8th Edition
home.lead: Unofficial practice questions aligned to the PMBOK Guide – Eighth Edition and the July 2026 PMP exam content outline, plus the classic question bank. Not affiliated with PMI.
home.domainPracticeDesc: Study one category at a time with immediate feedback.
home.timedExamDesc: Timed quiz: mixed bank, PMBOK 8 ECO-weighted exam, or the 180-question PMBOK 8 mock — explanations after you submit.

groupDesc.pmbok8: Seven performance domains, principles and new topics (AI, sustainability, PMO, procurement). Each question is tagged to the 2026 ECO.
groupDesc.pmbok8-mock: 180 scenario questions weighted to the 2026 ECO: People 33%, Process 41%, Business Environment 26%; ~40% predictive, ~60% agile/hybrid.
groupDesc.classic: The original question bank by knowledge area, kept for extra practice. Some references use earlier PMBOK editions.

exam.setupIntro: Choose a question source below. Duration defaults to the ratio of the July 2026 PMP exam: {{minutes}} minutes / {{questions}} questions — an informal study aid, not a PMI replica.
exam.randomizeNames: Randomize scenario names (same setting as domain practice)
exam.sourceAllDesc: Random sample across every category: PMBOK 8 bank plus the classic bank.
exam.sourceEcoDesc: PMBOK 8 questions only, sampled 33% People / 41% Process / 26% Business Environment.
exam.sourceMockDesc: All {{count}} mock questions in random order (240 minutes by default).

results.title: Exam results
results.timeExpired: Time expired — unanswered items count as incorrect.
results.informal: Informal pass threshold for practice: {{pct}}% — {{status}} threshold (not an official exam prediction).
results.reviewIntro: Explanations are shown for all items you missed (and for any you did not answer).
results.perfect: No incorrect answers on this attempt.
results.byEcoNote: Only PMBOK 8 questions carry ECO tags; classic questions appear as untagged.
